subject: Official SingleSource CMake population with upstream default inputs; no FP prefilter.

Clang-19 reference build; language classification comes from the complete CMake compilation database. Non-C programs are listed as excluded, not run or counted as passes; measurement tools stay reference-built.
Original lit output comparison, two workers, 60-second per-test wall limit; code-size/compile-time collection disabled because this is a correctness measurement.
CMake-generated Makefile2 recipes build the selected targets in one shared dependency graph; keep-going records independent build failures without aborting the other programs.
Only SingleSource and its build/lit support extracted; MultiSource/External data are not used.
